meta.promptText: Dark spots aur dull skin ke liye India mein konsa vitamin C serum kharidun?

response.text:
**Dark spots aur dull skin** ke liye India mein *ek safe, practical start* hota hai **10% Vitamin C serum**—especially agar aap beginner ho ya sensitive skin hai.[3] Agar aapko *stubborn pigmentation* hai aur skin Vitamin C tolerate karti hai, to **15%** tak move kar sakte ho.[3]

**Mere top practical picks (India)**
- **Pilgrim 10% Vitamin C Face Serum** — dull skin, beginner-friendly brightening, aur pigmentation ke liye good starting option.[12][3]
- **Minimalist 10% Advanced Vitamin C Serum** — effective daily brightening option, especially if you want a straightforward 10% formula.[16]
- **Foxtale C for Yourself Vitamin C Serum (15% L-Ascorbic Acid)** — better fit if dark spots zyada stubborn hain aur aap higher-strength serum use kar sakte ho.[14][3]
- **Garnier Bright Complete Vitamin C Serum** — more budget-friendly option for dullness and visible dark spots.[11]
- **Biotique Vitamin C Dark Spot Solution Serum** — dark spots, brightness, aur pigmentation-focused option, but ingredient robustness may vary by formula preference.[8][5]

**Kaunsa lena chahiye?**
- **Beginners / sensitive skin:** **Pilgrim 10%** ya **Minimalist 10%**.[12][16][3]
- **Stubborn dark spots / post-acne marks:** **Foxtale 15%** ya similar 15% formula.[14][3]
- **Budget option:** **Garnier** ya **Biotique**.[11][8]
- **Agar only one choose karna ho:** **10% stable Vitamin C serum + sunscreen** is the most balanced choice for Indian skin chasing brightness and fading dark spots.[3]

**Use kaise karein**
- Subah 2–3 drops lagaao, phir **sunscreen** zaroor use karo, because Vitamin C works best with sunscreen for pigmentation control.[3][7]
- Results usually gradual hote hain: dullness me pehle improvement aa sakta hai, while deeper dark spots ko more time lagta hai.[10][7]

**Quick caution**
- High-strength Vitamin C se irritation ho sakti hai, especially agar skin sensitive ho; stable 10% derivative formula beginners ke liye safer hota hai.[3]

Agar chaho, main **budget-wise 3 best options under ₹500 / ₹1000 / ₹1500** bhi shortlist kar deta hoon.
